meta.name: prisma-driver-adapter-implementation
meta.description: Required reference for Prisma ORM 7 SQL driver adapter work. Use when implementing or modifying adapters, adding database drivers, or touching SqlDriverAdapter, Transaction, savepoint, result mapping, or DriverAdapterError behavior. Covers current transaction lifecycle, optional savepoint hooks, original database-error preservation, and verification.

howto.what: 按 Prisma ORM 7 的适配器协议帮你实现或修改 SQL 驱动适配器:产出 queryRaw/executeRaw、事务与 savepoint、错误映射代码,并附带一份验证清单。
howto.when: 当你在实现或修改 Prisma 驱动适配器、新增数据库驱动,或改动事务、savepoint、结果映射等接口行为时接管。

say.text: 检查我的 startTransaction 是否每个事务独占一条连接
say.note: 会指出连接泄漏与重复提交/回滚问题

say.text: 把驱动错误映射为 DriverAdapterError,保留原始错误码和信息
say.note: 未映射的错误会保留细节用于 P2039 回退

howto.what_en: Implement or modify Prisma ORM 7 SQL driver adapters: it produces queryRaw/executeRaw, transaction and savepoint, and error-mapping code, plus a verification checklist.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you implement or modify a Prisma driver adapter, add a database driver, or touch transaction, savepoint or result-mapping interfaces.

say_en.text: Implement queryRaw and executeRaw for my driver adapter per the Prisma 7 adapter protocol
say_en.note: Returns example code mapping args and results by type

say_en.text: Check whether my startTransaction gives each transaction its own connection
say_en.note: Flags connection leaks and duplicate commit/rollback

say_en.text: Map my driver errors to DriverAdapterError, keeping the original code and message
say_en.note: Unmapped errors keep details for the P2039 fallback
